organism.common_name: Silurian Trilobite Holaspid Morphotype II (22 Thoracic Segments)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Aulacopleura koninckii_holaspis22 (15 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.locality: Na Černidlech Hill, Loděnice, Motol Formation, Prague Basin
paleobiology.transfer_note: Fusco et al. 2004 treat 18-22 thoracic segments as intraspecific morphs from one narrow interval. The 428.3 to 428.1 Ma split is MorphoEval chronoseries bookkeeping, not a measured speciation lag.

schnakenberg: du/dt = a - u + u^2 v + D_u laplacian(u)
dv/dt = b - u^2 v + D_v laplacian(v)
equations.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
equations.dispersion: sigma(k^2) = 0.5 * (tr + sqrt(tr^2 - 4 det)), tr = f_u + g_v - k^2 (D_u + D_v), det = (f_u - D_u k^2)(g_v - D_v k^2) - f_v g_u

state_variables.u: activator (local pigment / lens-precursor concentration on the cuticle patch)
state_variables.domain: periodic 2D patch of dorsal epithelium, physical spacing set so the analytical lambda_c equals 15.14 µm

boundary_conditions: Periodic (torus) via a five-point discrete Laplacian. Appropriate for a locally homogeneous cuticle patch at 15 µm, interior to a tergite. The trunk-scale positional gradient of Hughes et al. 2017 is not resolved on this patch; it enters only as the count of how many lambda_c tiles fit along the axis.

parameter_table.source_of_dyar: Hughes, Hong, Hou & Fusco 2017 Front. Ecol. Evol. 5:37 (meraspid 1.115, holaspid 1.103)
parameter_table.source_of_segment_counts: Fusco, Hughes, Webster & Minelli 2004 Am. Nat. 163:167-183 (five morphs, 18-22)

empirical_claims: Five holaspid morphs bear 18, 19, 20, 21 or 22 thoracic segments (Fusco et al. 2004).
Trunk segmentation is hemianamorphic: segments are added in an anamorphic phase, then the count is fixed in an epimorphic phase (Fusco et al. 2004; Hughes, Minelli & Fusco 2006).
The mature thoracic count is specified precociously, not by crossing a late size threshold (Fusco et al. 2004; Hughes et al. 2017).
Meraspid per-stage growth ratio is 1.115 and holaspid per-stage growth ratio is 1.103 (Hughes et al. 2017).
Thoracic release ends at stage s18 for morphotype t18 and at stage s22 for morphotype t22 (Hughes et al. 2017).
A shape transition near glabellar length 1.7 mm is not strictly tied to thoracic segment number (Hughes & Chapman 1995).
At stage s32, morphotypes with more thoracic segments have longer trunks and relatively shorter pygidia (Hughes et al. 2017).
The 15 µm figure is this slot's assigned cellular Turing wavelength. It is not a lens diameter measured by Fusco or Hughes.
